subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD model-cost estimates, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, or as a user display preference?
rationale: The request is useful, but the current code and docs define model costs as USD and repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement one documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, model catalog, status/session data, and UI display.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Reject a new model-cost currency field and direct provider balances or credits through the existing provider usage/billing unit path.

options.title: Make it display-only
options.body: Add a user display preference without changing model-cost numeric semantics, accepting that it is presentation-only and not provider metadata.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement one documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, model catalog, status/session data, and UI display.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current evidence points to recent ownership of the affected UI cost-display and config surfaces.
